title: In JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA before 2026.3 arbitrary file write was possible via symlinks when extracting plugin…
description: A vulnerability in JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA before version 2026.3 allows arbitrary file write via symlinks when extracting plugin archives. This flaw can be exploited by an attacker with local access to cause integrity and availability impacts by writing files arbitrarily on the system.
